description: Lethysia wears a full-length deep purple gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Broad gold woven floral-geometric borders decorate the neckline, front, waist and hem. A burgundy patterned wrap edged in gold rests loosely around her shoulders and arms, fixed by round red-centered fittings. A matching decorated girdle defines the waist. A small red-centered pendant, drop earrings, bracelet and ring provide modest jewelry. A decorated closed flat shoe appears beneath the lower skirt opening. Fabric is substantial and opaque with a finely woven or plush texture, though exact fibers cannot be verified. No headgear, armor or weapon appears.
